rule_or_requirement: The submission agent must recover from visual road loss using allowed pixels and actions, not simulator geometry.
observable_information: Four grayscale frames and the inherited pixel driver's action at each teacher intervention.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Fit fixed visual recovery models on completed TRAIN labels and evaluate without simulator driving on untouched whole TRAIN cells.
expected_success_endpoint: A visual student exceeds inherited steering on full-sequence teacher imitation, including sign switches and independent natural cells.
control: Inherited bend-rebound steering, with motion sign and fixed first-direction hold as additional diagnostic baselines.
falsifier: Any missing/hash-invalid data, natural first sign below 3/4, natural full-sequence sign below 75%, sign switches below 60%, or mean cell MAE not below inherited in both validation groups.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Fit 5170–5176 whole TRAIN cells, validate induced 5177 and four fresh natural 5292–5299 cells.
resource_and_risk_gate: One local CPU offline run capped at 240 seconds; no driving, reserved split, external action, or raw data copy.
